label: Restaurant / Cafe
description: Dine-in restaurants, cafes, bakeries, cloud kitchens with a physical counter.

headlineKpi.label: New reviews per week
headlineKpi.help: Restaurants live on recency. A listing that stopped collecting reviews reads as closed.

issueTaxonomy.label: Food quality / taste
issueTaxonomy.action: Re-standardise the two dishes named most often: fix the recipe card, weigh portions, and taste-check at the pass for one week.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the food not being up to standard

issueTaxonomy.label: Slow service
issueTaxonomy.action: Set a target ticket time per course and post it in the kitchen; assign one person to track tables waiting over that time.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: how long you waited to be served

issueTaxonomy.label: Wrong or missing items
issueTaxonomy.action: Add a repeat-back step: the server reads the full order back before sending it, and the pass checks the ticket before it leaves.

issueTaxonomy.label: Staff behaviour / attentiveness
issueTaxonomy.action: Assign every table an owner for the whole visit, and brief staff on how to handle a complaint at the table.
hints: no one came to the table
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the way the staff dealt with you

issueTaxonomy.label: Cleanliness / hygiene
issueTaxonomy.action: Add a visible washroom and table-turn cleaning checklist signed off every hour.

issueTaxonomy.label: Pricing / value for money
issueTaxonomy.action: Publish clear portion sizes and prices on the menu, and remove any charge that is not printed.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: feeling the bill was not worth it

issueTaxonomy.label: Long wait for a table
issueTaxonomy.action: Introduce a written waitlist with a quoted time, and honour the quote or comp nothing but apologise clearly.
hints: had to wait for a table
issueTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: table ke liye karna pade intezaar

issueTaxonomy.label: Ambience / noise / seating
issueTaxonomy.action: Fix the specific physical complaint named most often (AC, seating, music volume) before adding anything new.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: how uncomfortable it was to sit and eat

issueTaxonomy.label: Delivery / packaging problems
issueTaxonomy.action: Switch to leak-proof packaging for the items named, and seal every bag with a tamper sticker.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the state your order arrived in

issueTaxonomy.label: Billing errors / hidden charges
issueTaxonomy.action: Print every charge on the bill and train staff to explain the service charge before it appears.

praiseTaxonomy.label: Attentive service
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: aapka acche se dhyan rakha gaya

praiseTaxonomy.label: Good value for money
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseMarathi: पैसे योग्य खर्च झाले असे वाटले

praiseTaxonomy.label: Warm, welcoming staff
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the team made you feel welcome
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: team ne aapka swaagat acche se kiya

praiseTaxonomy.label: Menu variety
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: there was plenty to choose from
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: choose karne ko kaafi kuch tha

voicePreset.greeting: Thanks for eating with us and for writing in.
exampleReplies: Thanks for telling us — a cold main course is not what we want to send out. Please share the day and table with the manager on our counter number so we can trace it in the kitchen.
Really glad the biryani hit the spot. Passing this to the kitchen team.

staffAskScript.when: When clearing the table after the guest has finished and said they enjoyed the meal.
staffAskScript.line: Glad you enjoyed it. If you have a minute, there is a QR on the table card — your honest feedback really helps us.
staffAskScript.hinglishLine: Khushi hui aapko pasand aaya. Ek minute ho toh table card par QR hai — aapka honest feedback bahut help karta hai.
staffAskScript.marathiLine: आवडलं हे ऐकून छान वाटलं. एक मिनिट असेल तर टेबल कार्डवर QR आहे — तुमचा प्रामाणिक अभिप्राय खूप मदत करतो.
doNot: Never offer a discount, free dish or dessert in exchange for a review.
Never show the QR only to guests who looked happy.
Never write a review on a guest's phone.
Never ask a guest to take down a bad review.

profileGapChecks.label: No recent food or interior photos

contentTemplates.label: Reply — food complaint
contentTemplates.body:
Thank you for telling us, and sorry this one missed. That is not the standard we want on the pass. Please call the restaurant and mention the day and dish so we can trace it in the kitchen.

— {{businessName}}

contentTemplates.label: Reply — positive review
contentTemplates.body:
Thank you — this made the kitchen's day. See you on your next visit.

— {{businessName}}

contentTemplates.label: Table card subhead
contentTemplates.body: Scan and tell us honestly — good or bad.

kit.placement: On each table, and one at the billing counter.
kit.moment: When clearing the table, after the guest has finished the meal.
kit.headline: How was the food today?
kit.subhead: Scan and tell us honestly — good or bad.
kit.qrCaption: Scan to tell us how it was
kit.askMessage: Thanks for eating at {{businessName}}. If you have a minute, tell us honestly how it was — it genuinely helps the kitchen: {{reviewUrl}}
kit.askMessageHinglish: {{businessName}} me khaane ke liye shukriya. Ek minute ho toh honest feedback de dijiye — kitchen ko bahut help karta hai: {{reviewUrl}}
kit.askMessageMarathi: {{businessName}} मध्ये जेवल्याबद्दल धन्यवाद. एक मिनिट असेल तर प्रामाणिक अभिप्राय द्या — स्वयंपाकघराला खूप मदत होते: {{reviewUrl}}
kit.thankYou: Thank you — this goes straight to the kitchen team.
